交付AMR有效遮罩、格點預算與守恆測試。
在交接件中加入「AMReX：架構、所有權與資料介面」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：900有效粗格+800細格=1700；儲存若仍保留全部粗格會是1800，兩者不同；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：畫十個粗區塊其中一個細化為八子格，分開標有效、覆蓋及ghost類型；1700/2400正確，常數場體積總量守恆，儲存與有效量分欄。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver active masks, cell budgets, and conservation tests.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for AMReX: architecture,ownership and data interfaces: There are 900 active coarse cells and 800 fine cells, totaling 1700. Keeping covered coarse cells in storage gives 1800 before ghosts. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Draw ten coarse regions with one replaced by eight children. Label active, covered, and ghost categories separately. Verify 1700 and 2400 with constant-field conservation. Report storage separately from active cells. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。900有效粗格+800細格=1700；儲存若仍保留全部粗格會是1800，兩者不同；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. There are 900 active coarse cells and 800 fine cells, totaling 1700. Keeping covered coarse cells in storage gives 1800 before ghosts. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 900有效粗格+800細格=1700；儲存若仍保留全部粗格會是1800，兩者不同；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.checkEn: There are 900 active coarse cells and 800 fine cells, totaling 1700. Keeping covered coarse cells in storage gives 1800 before ghosts. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: AMReX支援區塊結構自適應網格；本課分清被覆蓋粗格、有效細格與儲存格。
knowledge.textEn: AMReX supports block-structured adaptive mesh refinement. Distinguish covered coarse cells, active fine cells, and stored cells.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 畫十個粗區塊其中一個細化為八子格，分開標有效、覆蓋及ghost類型；1700/2400正確，常數場體積總量守恆，儲存與有效量分欄。
knowledge.textEn: Draw ten coarse regions with one replaced by eight children. Label active, covered, and ghost categories separately. Verify 1700 and 2400 with constant-field conservation. Report storage separately from active cells.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 三維粗格N中比例f以每軸r倍細化，有效格數N(1−f)+Nfr³；覆蓋粗格不重複當有效。
knowledge.textEn: For refined fraction f and per-axis ratio r, active 3 D cells equal N(1−f) + N f r³. Covered coarse cells are excluded from active counts.
